final: WITH hand_counts AS (SELECT p.throws AS throwing_hand, COUNT(DISTINCT a.player_id) AS player_count FROM player_award AS a JOIN player AS p ON p.player_id COLLATE BINARY = a.player_id COLLATE BINARY GROUP BY p.throws), total AS (SELECT SUM(player_count) AS total_count FROM hand_counts), shares AS (SELECT h.throwing_hand, h.player_count, 1.0 * h.player_count / NULLIF(t.total_count, 0) AS share FROM hand_counts AS h CROSS JOIN total AS t WHERE t.total_count IS NOT NULL), mean_share AS (SELECT AVG(share) AS value FROM shares), above_mean AS (SELECT s.player_count, s.share, s.share - m.value AS excess FROM shares AS s CROSS JOIN mean_share AS m WHERE m.value IS NOT NULL AND s.share > m.value) SELECT SUM(player_count), AVG(share), AVG(excess) FROM above_mean
